title: C64 PAL RunFrame Throughput
body:
Managed C64 PAL emulation must execute `IMachine.RunFrame()` fast enough for a host application to sustain 50.125 Hz PAL playback with remaining budget for blit and audio work.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A production C64 PAL machine built through `ArchitectureBuilder` with real C64 ROMs is the measured target; romless and minimal-host machines are not valid evidence.
- After 60 warmup frames, a 600-frame Release/net10.0 managed-only run reports median frame time `<= 18.0 ms`.
- The same run reports p95 frame time `<= 22.0 ms`.
- The measured `RunFrame()` loop reports `0` bytes allocated on the current thread.
- Public signatures for `IMachine`, `IVideoChip`, `IAudioChip`, `IBus`, `IKeyboardMatrix`, `ArchitectureBuilder`, and `C64MachineProfiles` remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Production C64 PAL machine is built through ArchitectureBuilder with real C64 ROMs; romless and minimal-host machines are not valid evidence.
Release/net10.0 managed-only 60 warmup plus 600 measured frame run reports median <= 18.0 ms.
The same measured run reports p95 <= 22.0 ms.
The measured RunFrame loop reports 0 bytes allocated on the current thread.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: RunFramePerfProbe 60 600: allocated=0 bytes; BenchmarkDotNet Allocated reported no managed allocation

acceptanceCriteria.text: Public signatures for IMachine, IVideoChip, IAudioChip, IBus, IKeyboardMatrix, ArchitectureBuilder, and C64MachineProfiles remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: PR #3 diff only changes internal implementation plus benchmark/test/docs; no public interface signatures changed
